run_cotracker_demo: run the CoTracker demo script to predict point tracks on a video using argparse CLI
read_video_from_path: read a video from a file path and return frames as a numpy array
create_cotracker_predictor: create a CoTrackerPredictor model from a checkpoint file or via torch hub load
predict_tracks_on_video: predict point tracks and visibility on a video tensor using grid size and query frame
visualize_predicted_tracks: visualize predicted tracks and visibility on a video and save the result to a directory
